title: NOVONIX’ Mike O’Kronley Featured in Fastmarkets Interview
summary: NOVONIX CEO Mike O’Kronley spoke with Rachel McGuire, a @Fastmarkets author and price reporter, about U.S. graphite supply and its continued exposure to China.
body_markdown:
NOVONIX CEO Mike O’Kronley spoke with Rachel McGuire, a[@Fastmarkets](https://x.com/Fastmarkets) author and price reporter, about U.S. graphite supply and its continued exposure to China.


The interview examines challenges and policy issues for the U.S. graphite industry from Mike’s perspective, including:


- China’s role in global natural and synthetic graphite production
- The risks of potential restrictions on Chinese graphite exports
- Limited synthetic graphite capacity outside China and the economics of domestic production
- Policy measures that could support U.S. producers, including Section 232 tariffs and price floors


Read the full interview on[Fastmarkets](https://www.fastmarkets.com/insights/us-graphite-supply-exposed-to-china-despite-diversification-push/) .
